title: Farm Real Estate Loans Pricing Schedule — Autopay and Young-Farmer Rate Discounts
content:
Each FarmLand product of Farm Real Estate Loans carries four discount terms:

- **Autopay availability** — whether installments may be debited automatically (yes or no).
- **Autopay discount (percentage points)** — the discount while installments are collected by automatic debit.
- **Young-farmer land discount (percentage points)** — the discount for a member who holds a StartRight Operating Line in active status at closing or conversion.
- **Discount cap (percentage points)** — the most the autopay and young-farmer discounts may take off together.

## Discount terms by product

| Product | Autopay available | Autopay discount | Young-farmer land discount | Discount cap |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | yes | 0.10 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | 0.10 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | 0.10 | 0.5 | 0.5 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | yes | 0.10 | 0.25 | 0.3 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | yes | 0.0 | 0.0 | 0.0 |

## Points of reading

- Automatic debit of installments is available on every FarmLand product, but on the 15-Year and 25-Year Fixed Mortgages it carries no rate discount, and those two products carry no young-farmer land discount and a discount cap of 0.
- **Cap at work (derived from the table).** On the 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage the two discounts would come to 0.10 and 0.25, that is 0.35 points together; the cap of 0.3 holds the combined discount to 0.30 points. On the Variable-Rate, 3-Year and 5-Year products the two together come to 0.60 points and are held to the 0.5 cap.
- A member with only one of the two discounts receives that discount up to the cap; on every product shown, a single discount is within the cap.
